title.zh: 设立纤维检验服务局的法案
title.en: An Act Creating the Bureau of Fiber Inspection Service.
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Three Thousand Ninety-Nine, Entitled "An Act Creating the Bureau of Fiber Inspection Service."

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6108_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section nine of Republic Act Numbered Three thousand ninety-nine is amended to read as follows:
"Section 9. Disposition of Funds. —All the amounts collected as fees for grading permits, inspection fees, sale of specimens of the official standards and other income shall be deposited in the National Treasury of the Philippines: Provided, That the appropriations provided in the General Appropriations Act for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and seventy to cover expenses of the Bureau of Fiber Inspection Service shall be funded fully from the General Fund."
Section ten of the same Act is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
